by: tools/score/moods.mjs: the score room's cues rendered through its sampled orchestra (CC0 samples: Content/Studio/Music/samples)

calm.note: high piano notes far apart, a breath of strings, long silences

uneasy.note: low pizzicato taps like wood settling, tremolo swelling in and out

dread.note: a low string pedal swelling and ebbing, a dissonance creeping in, drips

chase.note: driving strings and pizzicato over low piano octaves, timpani, the key climbing
